audience: Fanvue AI-model operators with existing traffic
primary_intent: How to prepare an AI-persona account for outsourced Fanvue chatting

sources.used_for: Manager restrictions and broad default team-member scope

claims_basis: Operational checklist and examples are editorial recommendations, not claims about a measured client result. Initial estimate without account access and commercial CTA follow current published contact page/facts.json.
release_steps: Review the actual article and download
Assign real publication dates to visible byline, meta and Article schema
Remove draft noindex and draft notice
Add a contextual service-page link and blog card
Build/check, responsive and CTA QA, deploy and verify
Submit published article for discovery only after live verification

validation.static: Passed: one H1, unique IDs, existing local assets/links, valid schemas and SVG, no tokens, noindex and no public sitemap entry
validation.responsive: No horizontal page overflow or broken images at desktop, 768, 390 and 320 widths
validation.interaction: Contents anchors, keyboard FAQ disclosure and contact estimate destination passed
validation.no_javascript: Core reading/links/FAQ are native HTML; no browser-level disabled-JavaScript test performed
